event1: Safety Light stopping the payment of premiums
event2: PBGC's Financial Operations Department discovering this failure

facts.raw_text: the plan was established by safety light for the exclusive benefit of its employees

facts.entity: failure to pay required pension plan premiums
facts.raw_text: in march 2022, as a result of a pbgc premium filing review, pbgcs financial operations department (fod) discovered that safety light had failed to pay required pension plan premiums since in response to the referral, cfrd opened a case to investigate further.
